name: Sam drops out, then rejoins
description: A flatmate who cancels on a booked dinner and then changes his mind.
goals: First say he can't make the dinner at Luca's
After the agent confirms the change, say he can make it after all and wants back in
constraints: Wants a clear account of what was refunded and charged
initial_message: It's Sam. I can't make the dinner at Luca's, take me off please.
memory_facts: Dinner at Luca's is already booked
